_finding: The agent test grades answers against the issuers' lists and publishes a stamp. A grade that passes a wrong answer, a draw that offers a held or listed address as a wrong one, or a commitment without the secret nonce would put a false "Passed" on our page (docs/agent-test-tz.md v3).

mutations.name: one wrong answer no longer fails the test
mutations.find: return { passed: right === record.tasks.length, right, of: record.tasks.length, sentences }
mutations.replace: return { passed: right >= record.tasks.length - 1, right, of: record.tasks.length, sentences }
mutations.expect: FAIL one wrong answer of six is Not passed

mutations.name: refusing a listed contract counts as right
substituting the issuer contract is graded wrong
mutations.expect: FAIL substituting the issuer contract on a look-alike is right

mutations.name: a draw without look-alike material is filled anyway
held, unminted and paused records become eligible
mutations.expect: FAIL held, unminted and paused records are never eligible

mutations.name: the commitment drops the secret nonce
mutations.expect: FAIL the commitment changes with the nonce
